proof_obligations.PO-REPRESENTATION: True original-root residuals equal sums of normalized projective ridge tables with shared denominator3. Only global kernel divisibility is initially granted; individual table division can erase carries.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASS: Local native low linearity and cyclic difference identities prove additive degree<=2r+1. Affine pullback, addition and exact global division preserve the bound. No arbitrary asserted degree is trusted.
proof_obligations.PO-VALUATIONS: Local exact degree is max(0,2*(R-u)-1,2*(R-v)); its group maximum is a global upper bound, not equality. A derivative order above the bound is exactly certified by algebra, not random testing.
proof_obligations.PO-MERGE: One-use signed SUM injection and measured words yield Q(m+c*z) for arbitrary reference-entangled data. All outcomes have mass3^-d. Charge the whole source cohort, ancestor uniqueness, unused programs and source branches.
proof_obligations.PO-SUPPORT: Any nonzero additive polynomial of degree D has relative support>=2^-D by induction on a nonzero derivative and support-union bound. Vector codomains need no component-count factor.
proof_obligations.PO-TEST: A derivative identity with variable base/directions still has total additive degree<=D, not D-order. Kappa*2^D independent tests give false-accept upper2^-kappa. Commit each candidate before fresh tests and budget errors across adaptive searches.
proof_obligations.PO-STATUS: Seeded or insufficient tests give uncertified no-witness status. Passing random tests is not an exact proof or accepted algorithm. Explicit nonzero derivative witnesses falsify the claimed identity deterministically.
proof_obligations.PO-DEPTH: Real retained roots3/9/27 share a cubic merge policy. Exact local certificates show degree<=2r; roots9/27 have explicit nonzero third derivatives. Highest-top cancellation does not grant quadratic decoding or full-secret recovery.
proof_obligations.PO-SEARCH: A compact evaluator and polynomial-in-q identity verifier are not a useful relation finder or source-law proof. Implement and critique a concrete depth-independent cancellation policy before claiming leverage for decoding.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Local mathematical review is pending. Upstream input supply, correlated errors, aggregate gate costs, output label laws and comparison against known sieves remain separate.

falsifiable_experiments: Compact phase evaluation disagrees with original native frequencies at any retained word.
A native table exceeds the claimed cyclic degree, or local valuation certificates incorrectly certify a nonzero derivative as zero.
A purported higher-root quadratic merge has a nonzero third derivative; retain it as an exact counterexample rather than a whole-family no-go.
Seeded tests, reused/adaptive test points or an incomplete evaluation budget are assigned unconditional proof soundness.
